description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between "Evaluation Context Length" and "PPL" for three different parameter values, denoted in the legend as γ=0.25, γ=0.5, and γ=0.75. The x-axis is labeled "Evaluation Context Length" and features a discrete scale with values doubling at each evenly spaced tick mark, ranging from 2K to 64K (specifically marked at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K). The y-axis is labeled "PPL" and uses a linear scale with tick marks ranging from 7.7 to 8.1 at regular intervals of 0.1. The plot contains three solid lines, all utilizing circular markers. The blue line, representing γ=0.25, begins at approximately 8.16 at 2K, experiences a sharp decline to roughly 7.83 at 4K, rises slightly to 7.84 at 8K, drops to 7.78 at 16K, increases slightly to 7.79 at 32K, and ends at 7.78 at 64K. The orange line, representing γ=0.5, starts at approximately 8.17 at 2K, drops sharply to 7.84 at 4K, continues to decline to 7.74 at 8K, and then maintains a relatively steady, slight downward trend, ending at 7.73 at 64K. The green line, representing γ=0.75, also begins at approximately 8.17 at 2K, drops sharply to 7.84 at 4K, declines further to 7.75 at 8K, and continues a gradual decrease to end at 7.72 at 64K.
